items: Nails, bring more in case some break (12)
3 casts of Fire Wave or Fire Surge
rewards: Ability to make Super Antifire Potions
Access to the Fountain of Uhld.
Ability to purchase the Mythical Cape
Access to Adamant and Rune Dragons
Ability to re-forge the dragon platebody and kiteshield.
Ability to further upgrade your Ava's device.
Ability to teleport to Lithkren with the Digsite Pendant.

st.t: Talk to Alec Kincade outside the Myths' Guild.
s: How can I gain access to the guild?

st.t: Talk to Dallas Jones in the Pub on Musa Point.

Enter the Karamja volcano and go north through the dungeon to the secret wall at its north end. Go through it, follow the tunnels to Elvarg's Lair and climb over the wall to get in. Talk to Dallas there.
Use a pickaxe on the blockage in the north east of Elvarg's Lair.
Enter the passage in the north east of Elvarg's Lair.
Inspect the mural.
Kill the spawn.
Investigate the mural again.
Talk to Dallas about the mural.
Travel to the House on the Hill on Fossil Island. The fastest way here is with the digsite pendant.
Inside the house, go down the trapdoor to the basement and talk to Dallas.
s: So how do we know which island to go to?

st.t: Search the stone chest in the north of the room. Whilst finding map pieces you can talk to Dallas to give him your current pieces.
Climb the ladder to go upstairs in the house. Talk to Dallas if you want to give him your current map pieces.
Search the stone chest in the north of the house's top floor.
Leave the house down the stairs to the west.
Search the fungi north of the stairs.
Search the hook briar south of the house.
Search the mushtree east of the house.
Return to Dallas in the basement of the house and talk to him with the map pieces.
Tap the incomplete map in the middle of the room to open the puzzle. Tap a piece to turn it and drag pieces to swap them, until the map matches the solved picture.
Talk to Dallas after solving the map.
Talk to Jardric in the museum camp.
Build a rowing boat on the west coast of Fossil Island, on the shore just south-west of the Mushroom Meadow magic mushtree.
i: Nails, bring more in case some break (12)

st.t: Talk to Dallas near the boat, then board the boat to Lithkren.
On Lithkren, head north-west from the boat to the ruined courtyard and climb up the stairs on its west side.
Climb down the trapdoor to the south.
Climb down the staircase to the north.
Talk to Dallas in the far north of the room.
Search the skeleton east of Dallas.
Read Aivas' Diary.
Talk to Dallas again.

i: Nails, bring more in case some break (12)

st.t: Use a catspeak amulet (e) to locate Bob the Cat and talk to him. He's often in Catherby Archery Shop or at the Varrock Anvil.
Talk to the Sphinx in Sophanem.
s: Ask the Sphinx for help with Bob's memories.

st.t: Talk to the Oneiromancer in the south east of Lunar Isle. You need a dream vial from her for the next step, so if you don't have one afterwards, talk to her again.
Fill the vial with water at the sink just west of the bank in Lunar Isle's town.
Add a goutweed to the dream vial.
Use a hammer on an astral rune.
Use a pestle and mortar on the astral rune shards.
Add the ground astral rune to the dream vial.
Equip your combat equipment, food, and light the Brazier in the west of Lunar Isle's town. Be prepared for a fight. You will need melee gear, preferably a crush weapon, to fight.
Use the dream potion on the brazier.
Talk to Bob in the dream.
When you're ready, fight Robert. Use Protect from Missiles. When he shouts 'See if you can hide from this!', hide behind a pillar.
Talk to Bob next to the brazier.
Go down the staircase in the south east of the Kharazi Jungle. MAKE SURE TO HAVE AUTO-RETALIATE OFF BEFORE ENTERING.

Follow these moves to the centre of the maze, counted in squares from the bottom of the stairs. On the way, disarm spikes with Thieving, jump traps with Agility, and pray against the stone guardians: red is melee, green is ranged, blue is magic. First: 8 south, 4 west, 4 south, 7 west, 3 north, 8 west, 11 south.
Next: 4 east, 8 south, 4 east, 8 south, 4 east, 12 south, 11 east.
Next: 4 south, 5 east, 4 south, 4 east, 4 south, 7 east, 4 south, 4 east.
Next: 20 north, 4 east, 11 north, 10 west, 5 north, 1 west, 11 north.
Last: 3 east, 8 north, 3 west, 3 south, 4 west, 8 south, 4 west, 8 south, 8 west, 7 south. Take the key piece from the plinth in the centre.
Talk to Reldo in the Varrock Castle Library.
s: I'm looking for information on a Fourth Age hero.

st.t: Search the second bookcase from the north on the west side of the library's central row for the census. It has a red book on it.
Talk to Reldo again.
Talk to Sarah in the house just west of the bank in Port Phasmatys.
Talk to Ava in Draynor Manor.
s: I need your help with a key piece.

st.t: Use the glassblowing pipe on a dragonstone.
Talk to Ava again.
s: I need your help with a key piece.

st.t: Bring food: the locator orb hurts you each time you use it. Start at fairy ring BKR in Mort Myre and use the locator orb: it tells you which direction the key piece is. Walk that way and use it again, and keep following its directions to the spot, then dig there with your spade.
Talk to Amelia south west of the Shayzien Archery Store.
Enter the Crypt west of Amelia.

The crypt has three levels and the undead are aggressive, so keep moving. On the top level, go down the ladder in the north-east corner. On the middle level, go to the far east ladder and climb down to the bottom level. Then head to the centre and go through the southern doors.
Inspect the tomb in the south room.
Solve the crypt puzzle.
Inspect the tomb for the key.
Talk to Brundt in Rellekka.
Talk to Torfinn on the Rellekka docks to go to Ungael.

Defeat Vorkath. This is a hard fight, so if you're unfamiliar with it it's recommended you watch a video on it first. Protect from Magic, and drink an antifire and antivenom potion. When Vorkath fires a pink fireball it'll turn your prayer off. When Vorkath shoots an orange fireball into the air, move away from the spot you're on. When Vorkath spits acid everywhere, WALK around to avoid the fireballs he will shoot. When Vorkath freezes you, kill the zombified spawn that appears before it reaches you.
Climb over the ice chunks in the north of Vorkath's crater, then follow the path to the north-west of Ungael and enter the cave.
Pull the lever in the south west corner. Make sure you have run energy before doing so, as you need to run to the east room afterwards.
RUN to the east room.
Search the stone chest in the room for the key piece.
If you haven't already, do the Firemaking part of Barbarian Training and get the pyre ship instructions from Otto. Without them, the whirlpool washes you ashore.

Enter the Ancient Caverns through the whirlpool south of the Barbarian Outpost. Go down the stairs and run south along the east wall to the stairs up to the mithril dragons. Go up, run west and open the Mithril Door with your ancient key.
s: Yes, I wish to enter the unknown.
i: 3 casts of Fire Wave or Fire Surge

st.t: Cast fire wave or surge on the 3 dragon heads.

Leave the orb room, go east and back down the stairs to the ground floor. Run to the south-west corner of the caverns and climb up the rough steps there. Forge the dragon key on one of the anvils to the south.

Board the boat on the west coast of Fossil Island to Lithkren. In the ruined courtyard, climb up the stairs to the west, down the trapdoor to the south and down the staircase to the north. Follow the path down and use the dragon key on the grandiose door, just north of where you met Dallas.
Enter the grandiose doors and talk to Dallas in the new area.
Talk to Bob underground in Lithkren.

i: 3 casts of Fire Wave or Fire Surge

st.t: Talk to King Roald in Varrock Castle.
s: I'm here to talk about dragons.

st.t: Talk to Brundt in Rellekka.
Talk to Sir Amik Varze upstairs in Falador Castle.
Talk to King Lathas/Thoros upstairs in East Ardougne castle.
Enter the dining room just north of King Roald's throne room in Varrock Castle.
Talk to Bob in Varrock Castle.
Keep 4 inventory slots free. Talk to Torfinn on the Rellekka docks to go to Ungael. Be prepared for a lot of fighting.

Keep the boat afloat for 4 minutes. Take a swamp paste, water container, revitalisation potion and hammer from the crates on the ship: this is what your 4 free inventory slots are for. Use them to fill leaks, put out fires, heal warriors and repair the masts.

Put on your dragonfire protection and cross the wrecked ships to Varrock's grand ship, killing the red, iron and brutal green dragons on the way. The path goes west, north, east, north, east, north, east and north again, then back west along the top, south, and finally west to the main ship.
Kill the blue and green dragons.
Kill the black, steel, and brutal red dragon. Occasionally Galvek will shoot a fireball in the air, move to avoid it.
Kill the metal dragons. Occasionally Galvek will shoot a fireball in the air, move to avoid it.

Kill Galvek. This is a hard fight, so it's recommended you check a video to see what you'll have to do. Avoid the ground-targeted fireballs. The pink attack turns off prayer. Use Protect from Magic in phase 1, use Protect from Missiles otherwise. Phase 1 - Fire traps appear - if you go near them you die. Phase 2 - Fires transparent projectile which drains stats. Phase 3 - Waves of fire appear. Go through the gap in them to avoid. Phase 4 - Fires a binding projectile. Avoid it by moving.
Talk to Alec Kincade to become a Myth!
